headline: Growth accelerates as margins expand and outlook rises
summary_short: eBay reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $3,134M, up 14.8% y/y and 1.5% q/q, while diluted EPS of $1.21 rose 55.1% y/y as GAAP operating margin expanded to 21.6% from 17.6% a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue rose 14.8% y/y and 1.5% q/q to $3,134M, driven by 15% GMV growth (to $22.4B) and first-party advertising revenue up 25% y/y. GAAP operating income of $676M (+41.1% y/y) lifted operating margin to 21.6% from 17.6%, aided by a sharp drop in restructuring charges ($1M vs $55M) and a swing in legal-matter costs. Net income of $550M (+51.1% y/y) and diluted EPS of $1.21 (+55.1% y/y) also benefited from a lower GAAP tax rate (17.1% vs 22.6%). Cash fell to $2,310M q/q on a $750M senior-note repayment and continued buybacks ($310M) and dividends ($138M). eBay raised full-year revenue and EPS outlook, and guided Q3 2026 revenue of $3.07-3.12B and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.36-1.42.

drivers.explanation: GMV rose 15% (14% FX-neutral) to $22.4B on broad-based marketplace demand, plus first-party advertising revenue up 25% y/y.
GAAP operating margin expanded to 21.6% from 17.6%, aided by lower restructuring/executive-bonus charges ($1M vs $55M) and a swing in legal-matter costs.
Net income growth was aided by a lower GAAP effective tax rate of 17.1%, down from 22.6% a year ago.
Diluted share count fell 3.2% y/y as the company repurchased $310M of stock in the quarter, continuing its buyback program.

Management raised full-year revenue and EPS outlook citing strong momentum, and guided Q3 2026 revenue of $3.07-3.12B and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.36-1.42, which reflect the newly closed Depop acquisition.
